Class WebFluxConfigurationSupport

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.web.reactive.config.WebFluxConfigurationSupport
All Implemented Interfaces:
Aware, ApplicationContextAware
Direct Known Subclasses:
DelegatingWebFluxConfiguration
public class WebFluxConfigurationSupport extends Object implements ApplicationContextAware
The main class for Spring WebFlux configuration.

直接导入或扩展并覆盖受保护的方法以进行自定义。

Since:
5.0
Author:
Rossen Stoyanchev，Brian Clozel

    • setApplicationContext

      public void setApplicationContext(@Nullable ApplicationContext applicationContext)
      描述从接口复制：ApplicationContextAware
      Set the ApplicationContext that this object runs in. Normally this call will be used to initialize the object.

      在普通 Bean 属性填充之后、但在初始化回调（例如 InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet()）或自定义 init-method 之前调用。在 ResourceLoaderAware.setResourceLoader(ResourceLoader)、ApplicationEventPublisherAware.setApplicationEventPublisher(ApplicationEventPublisher) 和 MessageSourceAware（如果适用）之后调用。

      Specified by:
      `setApplicationContext` 在接口 `ApplicationContextAware` 中。
      Parameters:
      applicationContext - 此对象将使用的 ApplicationContext 对象
      See Also:
      • BeanInitializationException

    • webFluxValidator

      @Bean public Validator webFluxValidator()
      Return a global Validator instance for example for validating @RequestBody method arguments.

      委托给getValidator() 首先。如果该调用返回null，则在创建OptionalValidatorFactoryBean之前检查类路径中是否存在 JSR-303 实现。如果不可用 JSR-303 实现，则返回一个“无操作”的Validator。
